collection.description: A builder asks whether distant people might live in dwellings built above one another.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A builder asks whether distant people might live in dwellings built above one another, with many families sharing one enormous structure.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The model collapses, reminding everyone that a tall building needs more than ambition.

text_only.reason: a small model collapses; no building of the village is damaged

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Children invent neighbors borrowing salt across floors and complaining about noise.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder wonders how someone unable to climb steps would reach the top; accessibility becomes central to the design.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The builders admire the potential to shelter many people on limited land.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A farmer worries about gardens, waste, and fresh air; the imagined city grows more complicated.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: A stable miniature tower inspires a useful discussion of weight and supports.
